title: LLMODE: Aligning ODEs with LLMs via Gated Token Injection for Irregular Spatio-Temporal Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2608.29640v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for spatio-temporal forecasting, but existing approaches often rely on regularly sampled token sequences and struggle with irregular observations because of temporal asynchrony, representation-space misalignment, and limited context windows. We propose LLMODE, a token-efficient framework for irregular spatio-temporal forecasting with a frozen LLM backbone. LLMODE first uses a graph-aware ODE encoder to reconstruct irregular graph observations as a continuous-time latent trajectory. A Fixed-Budget Perceiver Resampler then compresses this variable-length trajectory into a fixed number of dynamic memory tokens. In parallel, compact statistical descriptors are encoded and resampled into context memory tokens. translated_title: LLMODE：通过门控令牌注入将常微分方程与大语言模型对齐，实现不规则时空预测
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）在时空预测方面展现出巨大潜力，但现有方法通常依赖规则采样的令牌序列，由于时间异步性、表示空间不对齐以及有限的上下文窗口，难以处理不规则观测数据。我们提出LLMODE，这是一个基于冻结LLM骨干的令牌高效的不规则时空预测框架。LLMODE首先使用图感知ODE编码器将不规则的图观测数据重建为连续时间的潜在轨迹。随后，固定预算感知重采样器将这一变长轨迹压缩为固定数量的动态记忆令牌。与此同时，紧凑的统计描述符被编码并重采样为上下文记忆令牌。双源门控交叉注意力模块将这两种记忆注入冻结的LLM中，实现对外部时空证据的可控利用。在三个真实世界（数据集）上的实验……
tldr: LLMODE提出了一种基于冻结LLM的令牌高效框架，通过图感知ODE编码器、固定预算感知重采样器和双源门控交叉注意力机制，实现了对不规则采样时空数据的高效预测。
en_tdlr: LLMODE is a token-efficient framework that uses a graph-aware ODE encoder, fixed-budget perceiver resampler, and dual-source gated cross-attention to inject irregular spatio-temporal evidence into a frozen LLM for forecasting.
